verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The change adds a fail-closed scheduled certification of the triage planner's derived label vocabulary against the repository label set. The vocabulary is derived from the actual role tables plus the non-role producers, the CLI rejects empty input and names drift, and the independent job has read-only permissions. The tests pin the expected vocabulary independently, exercise table repointing, empty/clean/missing CLI outcomes, producer closure, and execute the exact workflow step against complete and deficient label sets. I found no diff-supported correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue requiring changes.
